n1.text: A. Each setting is a tile showing its value large. Drag anywhere on a tile to change it; the bar along its foot shows where it sits. One dark tile holds the picture.

n2.text: B. Settings are columns you pull up and down, so the whole editor reads as one chart. The one you are touching turns purple. Meters are just two more columns.

n3.text: C. The numbers are the controls: drag a value to scrub it. A light sheet of settings overlaps a dark glass that holds the picture.

n4.text: Dark theme: the sheet becomes the lighter of two dark greys, so it still stands off the glass.

n5.text: Purple appears only while a value is being changed, so it always means: this is what you are touching.

n6.text: More settings than fit: they are grouped, and each group's tab is a tiny chart of its values, so nothing is hidden. The plugin here is made up to test the layout.
